bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'STK04_RUNTIME_AUDIT_BEGIN\n'
printf 'PROJECT_PWD='; pwd
printf 'PROJECT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'PROJECT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'PROJECT_DIRTY='; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" && echo NO || echo YES
for f in artifacts/bot/src/services/stickerTopicEntryPin.ts artifacts/bot/scripts/ensureStickerTopicPin.ts artifacts/bot/dist/sticker-topic-pin.mjs artifacts/bot/src/db/migrate.ts; do if test -f "$f"; then echo "SOURCE_PRESENT=$f"; else echo "SOURCE_MISSING=$f"; fi; done
printf 'DEPLOY_FILES\n'; find deploy -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*compose*' -o -iname '*sticker*' \) -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 24 || true
printf 'RELEVANT_CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'gaybbs|videobot|create|postgres' | head -n 18 || true
printf 'TOPIC_TABLES\n'; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.posting_topics'),to_regclass('public.posting_sticker_entry_pins')" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE
printf 'STICKER_TOPIC_ROWS\n'; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT topic_id,board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled,(verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL) AS verified FROM posting_topics WHERE board_key='video_chat' AND (purpose='sticker' OR title ILIKE '%ステッカー%') ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 8" 2>/dev/null || echo TOPIC_ROWS_UNAVAILABLE
printf 'STK04_RUNTIME_AUDIT_END\n'
